interface.title: 联安智盾 (Lian'an Zhidun): multi-layer collaborative security protection and visual validation platform for federated learning (fl-backdoor-system)
interface.field: Machine-learning security / federated learning (backdoor attacks and defenses)
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment design, execution and comparison of results (simulation benchmarking)
interface.what_it_is_for: Set up a federated-learning simulation with a chosen backdoor attack (BadNets, WaNet, frequency, DBA, FCBA) and a stack of client-side, server-side and aggregation defenses, run it with live ACC/ASR/loss charts, and keep, inspect and compare the stored runs.

data.note: The MNIST training set (60,000 images) is bundled and is used by the backdoor preview. The interface is entirely in Chinese. No experiment finished in this session: every launch returned HTTP 500 '后端处理失败' (backend processing failed) and the downloaded run.log was empty (0 bytes, per the downloaded file; no screen shows it). So no ACC/ASR values, charts, CSVs or comparison plots were ever produced, and history only holds failed runs marked 指标不完整 (incomplete metrics).

tree.general: Measure how well defenses protect a distributed training process against backdoor poisoning
tree.specific: Run federated-learning experiments with and without backdoor attacks and defenses, then compare ACC/ASR across runs

features.name: Trigger / perturbation preview on a dataset sample
features.general: Before running anything, pick a perturbation method and a sample, and see the original next to the modified version with a count of changed pixels. For split triggers, also choose which participant's part to show.
features.specific: 后门样本预览 (backdoor sample preview): choose 对抗类型 (BadNets/WaNet/frequency/DBA/FCBA), step through MNIST training images with 上一张/下一张 (previous/next) or an image number, and see the original vs. poisoned image, the target label and 变化像素 (changed pixels). For DBA/FCBA, set 预览客户端 ID (preview client ID) to compare that client's local trigger with the full ASR-evaluation trigger. It uses unsaved form values and never starts a run.
steps: Choose an attack type in the 对抗类型 dropdown
Set the training-image number or press 下一张 / 上一张
For DBA/FCBA, type a 预览客户端 ID
Press 刷新预览 (refresh preview) and compare the panels and the changed-pixel count
serves_tasks: Choose the poisoning method and check what the trigger does to a sample

features.name: Layered method selector with method-dependent parameter groups
features.general: Build a processing pipeline by picking one method for each stage (participant side, server-side screening, aggregation). Each choice shows only the parameters it needs, edited fields are highlighted, and every field has a help tooltip naming its config key.
features.specific: 防御参数 (defense parameters) card: 客户端防御 (无防御 / 特征过滤), 服务端检测 (无检测 / Z-Score / 余弦相似度 cosine similarity / 分数阈值过滤 score threshold / K-means) and 聚合防御 (FedAvg / 范数裁剪 / 修剪平均 / Krum). Choosing K-means reveals the 服务端检测参数 group (cosine floor, min kept clients, max reject fraction, 启用过滤 enable-filter switch, percentile, weights, silhouette, cluster gap). Choosing Krum reveals 预估恶意数 (expected malicious count) and Krum 选择数 (Krum k). Changed fields get red borders and a 有未保存的更改 (unsaved changes) badge; the ? tooltips show the TOML key.
steps: Open each stage dropdown and pick a method
Fill in the parameter group that appears for that method
Hover the ? icon to read the key and meaning
Press 保存配置 (save configuration); the section badge changes to 所有更改已保存 (all changes saved)
serves_tasks: Add layered defenses against the attack
Set up a clean reference configuration with no attack and no defense

features.name: Configuration versioning: save, reset and backup manager
features.general: Saving the settings form keeps a backup automatically. You can discard edits, return to the last backup, or pick a named backup from a list, and choose whether to back up the current state first.
features.specific: 保存配置 writes pyproject.toml and a .bak. The 重置 (reset) menu offers 撤销未保存的更改 (discard unsaved changes), 恢复到上次备份 (.bak) (restore last backup) and 从备份列表恢复 (restore from list). The restore dialog asks for an optional backup name and offers 仅恢复不备份 (restore only) or 恢复并备份 (restore and back up). 备份管理 (backup management) lists backups with 查看/恢复/删除 (view/restore/delete) and 立即备份当前配置 (back up now).
steps: Press 保存配置 to save and create a backup
Hover 重置 and choose a restore option
In the restore dialog, optionally name a backup of the current state and confirm
Open 备份管理 to view, restore or delete named backups
serves_tasks: Roll the configuration back to an earlier saved version
Set up a clean reference configuration with no attack and no defense

features.name: Raw config file editor with import/export
features.general: Behind a warning, edit the whole configuration file as text, download or import it, back it up, or save and apply it.
features.specific: 高级模式 (advanced mode): a warning dialog, then a pyproject.toml text editor with 下载 (download), 导入 (import), 取消 (cancel), 仅创建备份 (create backup only) and 保存并应用 (save and apply). The downloaded file holds the [tool.flwr.app.config] keys the form edits.
steps: Press 高级模式 and confirm 进入 (enter)
Read or edit the TOML text
Press 下载 to export, or 导入 to load a file
Press 仅创建备份 or 保存并应用, or 取消
serves_tasks: Inspect or export the raw configuration file

features.name: Run launcher with status, live charts and log console
features.general: Name a run, start or stop it, and watch a status tag, two charts (one with two metrics, one with loss) and a streaming log. Errors show as a toast and an alert.
features.specific: 实验控制 (experiment control): name field (names are auto-suffixed to stay unique), 启动实验 / 停止实验 (start/stop), a status tag (空闲 idle → loading → outcome), the 准确率与攻击成功率 · ACC / ASR chart, the 训练损失 · Loss chart and the 运行日志 (run log) console. Only the idle, starting and failed states were seen; the charts and log never received data.
steps: Type a run name
Press 启动实验
Watch the status tag, the ACC/ASR and Loss charts, and the log
Press 停止实验 to stop, or read the failure alert
serves_tasks: Launch a configured run and follow its status, accuracy/attack-success charts and log

features.name: Run history cards with detail modal and file exports
features.general: Search a card grid of past runs that shows headline metrics and status. Open one for its metrics table, the exact configuration it used, and downloads of logs, CSVs and charts.
features.specific: 历史实验记录 (experiment history): search by name or UUID, cards showing ACC/ASR/Loss/AUC/rounds/dataset with 失败 (failed) and 指标不完整 (incomplete metrics) tags, plus 生成图表 / 下载文件 / 删除 (generate charts / download files / delete). The 实验详情 modal shows the UUID with a copy button, the status alert, a 指标汇总 (metrics summary) table and the 实验配置快照 (config snapshot) TOML, with buttons for 主日志 CSV (main log), 客户端日志 CSV (client log), 检测指标 CSV (detection metrics; these three are disabled until metrics exist), 下载运行日志 (download run log), 下载图表 (ZIP) (charts), 下载全部文件 (ZIP) (all files) and 查看运行日志 (view run log).
steps: Type a name or UUID and press 搜索 (search)
Click a card to open 实验详情
Expand 实验配置快照 to see the exact settings
Press 查看运行日志 or a download button to export files
serves_tasks: Find a past run and open its full record
